title: 自我介紹
description: 介紹自己的基本資訊與背景

sentences.en: My name is David, nice to meet you.
sentences.zh: 我叫 David，很高興認識你。

sentences.en: I'm from Taiwan.
I work as a software engineer.
I'm twenty-five years old.
I graduated from National Taiwan University.
My hobbies are reading and traveling.
sentences.zh: 我的嗜好是閱讀和旅行。

sentences.en: I've been living here for three years.
I'm currently studying English.
I have two brothers and one sister.
sentences.zh: 我有兩個哥哥和一個姊姊。

sentences.en: I enjoy cooking in my free time.
I'm a morning person.
I moved here last year for work.
sentences.zh: 我去年因為工作搬到這裡。

sentences.en: I'm interested in photography.
I speak Chinese and a little English.
sentences.zh: 我會說中文和一點英文。

sentences.en: I'm the youngest in my family.
I just started a new job last month.
sentences.zh: 我上個月剛開始一份新工作。

sentences.en: I like to play basketball on weekends.
I'm originally from Taipei.
I majored in business administration.
I've been working here for five years.
I love watching movies, especially comedies.
sentences.zh: 我喜歡看電影，尤其是喜劇。

sentences.en: I'm married and have two kids.
I'm a big fan of Japanese food.
I usually go jogging in the morning.
I'm looking forward to working with you.
sentences.zh: 我很期待和你一起工作。

sentences.en: My dream is to travel around the world.
I have a pet dog named Lucky.
sentences.zh: 我有一隻寵物狗叫 Lucky。

sentences.en: I consider myself a friendly person.
sentences.zh: 我覺得自己是個親切的人。

sentences.en: I'm passionate about learning new things.
sentences.zh: 我對學習新事物充滿熱情。

sentences.en: Please feel free to ask me anything.
sentences.zh: 有什麼問題都可以問我。
